verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's docs say the ClickHouse s3() and url() table functions "work as documented," so files in object storage can be read through SQL. However, that mention sits in an ingestion context, and nothing shows querying Iceberg, Delta or even Parquet files in place without loading them. missing for 10: any evidence of Iceberg or Delta Lake table support, explicit Parquet in-place query documentation, docs framing s3() as direct querying rather than ingestion, independent or hands-on corroboration.
